verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 106.7 (+2.1% in a day) and momentum is 47: prices are steady. 84s cost 900, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,400. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-23T01:00:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Pedro Neto 83 Team of the week after its 66% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 82,000 coins. Now 84,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 66.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 4,600 coins. Now 5,400. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 4,600 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 900 (1.08 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,400 (1.32 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,100 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 88s 13,750 (1.66 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Antoine Griezmann and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Antoine Griezmann 85 Team of the week -61.2%; Jarrod Bowen 84 Team of the week -60.7%; Pedro Neto 83 Team of the week -58.4%; Luis Díaz 89 Team of the week -40.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Johan Manzambi SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 63.9K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
